hook: An antibody against myostatin eased the muscle loss that comes with semaglutide weight loss.
hook_turn: eased the muscle loss that comes with semaglutide weight loss.

readout.label: Adults with obesity enrolled in COURAGE trial

summary: In a 975-person phase 2 trial, adding the myostatin-blocking antibody trevogrumab to semaglutide left people with less lean mass lost at week 26 than semaglutide alone (about 3 points less). Adding a second antibody, garetosmab, helped more but caused more serious side effects and dropouts, including two deaths. Only body composition was measured, so whether it protects strength or health is unknown.
title: Trevogrumab (anti-GDF8) with or without garetosmab (anti-activin A) for prevention of muscle loss during semaglutide-induced weight reduction in people with obesity (COURAGE): a two-part, phase 2, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised trial.
